text.en:
Whenever it shall atroear from the canvass in a regular or special election for Member of the
National Assembly that two or more candidates have obtained the same plural number of votes, the provincial
board of canvassers concerned shall proclaim that candidate elected who shall be favored by fortune in the
drawing herein provided for, and the candidate so proclaimed shall he entitled to a seat in the National
Assembly as if he had obtained a majority of votes.

As soon as the canvass shall result in a tie, the provincial board of canvassers, after stating this
fact in the proper certificate, and after giving all tied candidates ten days' notice in order that they may be
present if they so desire, shall hold another public session at which a drawing shall be held, and minutes shall
forthwith be prepared of the procedure followed in the drawing, of the result of said drawing and of the
proclamation of the candidate-elect. Certified copies of said minutes shall be sent to the National Assembly,
the President of the Philippines, and the Auditor General, and to each of the tied candidates.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved. November 18, 1936.
